entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant herein faced trial and was convicted for committing offence under 306 of the Indian Penal Code and was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 5 (five) years and also to pay a fine of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand) and in default to undergo simple imprisonment for six months.

Though the appellant was initially charged also under the provisions of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, but the Trial Court had acquitted him from the charges framed under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As per the prosecution case, deceased girl was having an affair with the appellant and the appellant later on refused to marry the deceased, as a result of which, she committed suicide.

Though there is allegation of commission of sexual assault, but the fact is that the appellant has been acquitted of the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The appellant has remained in custody for about 16 months.

Considering the nature of allegation and the materials surfaced during trial, I am inclined to allow Chandan Singh @ Chandan Singha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47899017/
1 privilege of bail to the appellant.

entities.text: Chandan Singh @ Chandan Singha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly, keeping the order of sentence under suspension during the pendency of this appeal, appellant, namely, Chandan Singh @ Chandan Singha is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Special Judge,
Jamtara-cum-Additional Sessions Judge-I, Jamtara in connection with Special POCSO Case No.06 of 2019 arising out of Kundahit Police Station Case No.42 of 2018, with a condition that the appellant shall appear before the Registrar, Civil Courts, Jamtara once every four months till disposal of the present appeal.

sentences.text: This interlocutory application is, accordingly, allowed.

opennyai_summary.facts:
Though the appellant was initially charged also under the provisions of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, but the Trial Court had acquitted him from the charges framed under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
As per the prosecution case, deceased girl was having an affair with the appellant and the appellant later on refused to marry the deceased, as a result of which, she committed suicide.
Though there is allegation of commission of sexual assault, but the fact is that the appellant has been acquitted of the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

This interlocutory application is, accordingly, allowed.
